name: BN6's hurt sound on a lethal hit
why: A hit that takes its object's HP to 0: BN6's damage routine plays the hurt sound (0x6B MegaMan's, 0x6D another's) before it tests the HP left, BN5's skips it on a lethal hit (its test first): the engine's damage step, not the family's code, a song in BN6's frame alone, those two alone (the deletion that follows is compared).
evidence: BN6 0x0801BA3C: bl 0x0800E2D8; push {r1}; movs r4,#0x6D ... movs r4,#0x6B; bl 0x080005CC; pop {r1}; tst r1,r1
BN5 0x080185C4: bl 0x0800C6D8; tst r1,r1; beq 0x080185FE, past its sound 0x080185D0-0x080185E8
zomon_v3 at t1084 and zomon_v3ex at t760: MegaMan's HP 0 in both at t1083 and t759, song 0x6B in BN6's frame alone, its event's caller the engine's (0x0801BA5F)
